desc:
• CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Hearty whole grain oats and chocolate chips in a chewy bar topped with delicious chocolate flavored drizzle; Help satisfy your cravings without sacrificing taste

  • FIBER SNACKS: 9g of fiber per bar - that's 33% daily value of fiber, so you'll feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth; 4g of total fat per bar

  • OATS AND CHOCOLATE: Rich chocolate chips and hearty oats help satisfy your cravings without sacrificing taste

  • PANTRY AND LUNCH BOX FAVORITE: Grab and go chewy bars for an office snack, after breakfast treat, or on the go; Or pack a fiber bar with lunch

  • CONTAINS: One 7 oz box of Fiber One Oats and Chocolate Flavored Chewy Bars; Five bars
features:
Features

Only 80 Calories Per Bar
A low-calorie snack option ideal for those watching their intake.

6 g Dietary Fiber (22% Daily Value)
A significant source of fiber to support digestive regularity and health.

Only 1 g Added Sugar
Helps reduce sugar spikes and supports low-sugar diets.

5 g Net Carbs
Suitable for those on reduced-carb meal plans.

Made with Whole Grain Oats and Chicory Root Fiber
Adds texture and prebiotic fiber for gut health.

Individually Wrapped and Portable
Convenient for lunchboxes, travel, or quick snacking.

Rich Chocolate Flavor with a Light Drizzle
Balances indulgence with health-conscious ingredients. 

 Benefits

Digestive Health Support
High fiber content promotes gut regularity and overall digestive wellness.

Smart Sweet Craving Solution
Offers a dessert-like taste without excessive sugar or calories.

Great for On-the-Go Snacking
Ready to eat, no prep needed—perfect for busy routines.

Portion-Controlled
Helps manage snacking without overindulging.

Suitable for a Variety of Diets
Low in sugar and calories, fits into weight management and reduced-carb diets.
ingredients: Chicory Root Extract, Whole Grain Oats, Semisweet Chocolate (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Corn Syrup, Rice Flour, Whole Grain Barley Flakes, Sugar, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Palm Kernel Oil, Maltodextrin, Soy Lecithin, Tricalcium Phosphate, Sugarcane Fiber, Cocoa Powder, Salt, Fructose, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Barley Malt Extract, Cellulose Gum, Baking Soda, Milk Powder, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
